title: Đảo Ngữ (Inversion) – Luyện Tập
summary: Tổng hợp bài tập trắc nghiệm đảo ngữ từ cơ bản đến nâng cao.

exercises.question: Only when he started working with her, ____that she was intelligent.
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause + đảo ngữ: did he realize.

exercises.question: Only after food has been dried or canned _______________.

options.text: it should be stored for future use
that it should be stored for future use
should it be stored for future use
should it store for future use

exercises.explanation: Only after + clause + đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề chính: should it be stored.

exercises.question: ____worked outside the home as nowadays.
exercises.explanation: Never đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: Never have so many women.

exercises.question: No longer____any pleasure to do this job.
exercises.explanation: No longer + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: do I have.

exercises.question: John stops smoking.

options.text: John does not smoke no longer

exercises.explanation: Chọn phương án viết lại đúng nghĩa dùng đảo ngữ với No longer: No longer does John smoke.

exercises.question: Only when you grow up____the truth.
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính dạng tương lai: will you know.

exercises.question: No sooner had he arrived home____he was called out again.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc No sooner... than... (vừa mới... thì đã...).

exercises.question: ____had the restaurant opened____people were flocking to eat there .
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc tương ứng: No sooner had ... than.

exercises.question: Down____for three days.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ với trạng từ chỉ phương hướng: Down + động từ chính (poured) + chủ ngữ (the rain).

exercises.question: Out _____ when the bell rang.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ: Out + động từ chính (ran) + chủ ngữ (the children).

exercises.question: Such____that he would stop at nothing.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Such + be + N + that... Đảo ngữ với Such: Such was his ambition.

exercises.question: Only once____late to school.
exercises.explanation: Only once + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did he come (động từ nguyên mẫu).

exercises.question: He no longer collects stamps as he used to. No longer____

options.text: he collects stamps as he used to
does he collect stamps as he used to
does he collected stamps as he used to
doesn’t he collect stamps as he used to it

exercises.explanation: No longer + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does he collect stamps...

exercises.question: ____, a matter is formed of molecules.

options.text: It doesn’t matter if the complex
No matter how complex it is
How complex is not a matter

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc nhượng bộ: No matter how + adj + S + be.

exercises.question: No more ____to worry about the future sources of energy.
exercises.explanation: No more + đảo ngữ thể khẳng định: do we have.

exercises.question: Hardly____asleep when the phone woke him up again.
exercises.explanation: Hardly + had + S + PII + when + clause.

exercises.question: Not until darkness fell____he hadn’t done half of his work.
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause / time + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính: did he realize.

exercises.question: Seldom____of Nancy Johnson as coloured.
exercises.explanation: Seldom đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did her school classmates think.

exercises.question: On the hill ____ a big pine tree.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ với trạng ngữ chỉ vị trí: On the hill + stands (chia số ít theo a big pine tree).

exercises.question: Not once ____ into her eyes.
exercises.explanation: Not once (không một lần nào) + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did he look.

exercises.question: Not until next year____ take place.
exercises.explanation: Not until + time + đảo ngữ tương lai đơn: will the new tax change.

exercises.question: Not until a monkey is several years old …..…to exhibit signs of independence from its mother.
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính: does it begin.

exercises.question: .………….. did Jerome accept the job.

options.text: Only because it was interesting work
Because it was an interesting work
Only because it was interested work

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Only because + clause + đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề chính.

exercises.question: ………..great was the destruction that the south took decades to recover.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ với So: So + adj (great) + be + S + that...

exercises.question: ………….….when the Charges found themselves 7-0 down.
exercises.explanation: Hardly had + S + PII... when + clause.

exercises.question: Not until the first land plants developed………………..
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did land animals appear.

exercises.question: Not until it was too late ………………. to call Susan.
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause + đảo ngữ: did I remember.

exercises.question: Never before …………………. such a wonderful child.
exercises.explanation: Never before + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: have I seen.

exercises.question: Hardly had we settle down in our seats …………….. the lights went out.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Hardly... when...

exercises.question: Only after checking three times …………certain of the answer.
exercises.explanation: Only after + V-ing + đảo ngữ: was I (chủ ngữ 'I' chia 'was').

exercises.question: Only when he is here, ……………
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does he speak.

exercises.question: ________, you would have succeeded in your business.

options.text: If you listened to my advice
Were you to listen to my advice
Had you listened to my advice
As long as you listened to my advice

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + PII.

exercises.question: She doesn’t like classical music and ____.
exercises.explanation: Đồng tình phủ định: 'I don't, either' hoặc 'neither do I' đều đúng.

exercises.question: Little ______________ what he has caused to others.
exercises.explanation: Little đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does he know.

exercises.question: ______ had he entered the office than he realized that he had left his wallet at home.
exercises.explanation: Liên từ 'than' đi kèm với 'No sooner'.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: We cannot clean up all the polluted seas and rivers. Nor we can stop the disappearance of plants and animals.
exercises.explanation: Nor đứng đầu câu làm liên từ nối, phải đảo ngữ: 'Nor can we'.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: Hardly had he entered the office when he realized that he forgot his wallet.
exercises.explanation: Hành động 'forgot' xảy ra trước 'realized' nên phải chia quá khứ hoàn thành: 'had forgotten'.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: It was not until he was 30 did he get married , had a job and lived independently of his parents.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc nhấn mạnh 'It was not until... that + clause (không đảo ngữ)' -> sửa thành 'that he got married'.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: Never before has so many people in the U.S been interested in soccer.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'so many people' số nhiều nên sửa 'has' thành 'have'.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: Not only he spent all his money but he also borrowed some from me
exercises.explanation: Not only đứng đầu câu phải đảo ngữ: 'did he spend'.

exercises.question: We couldn’t relax until all the guests had left.

options.text: Not until all the guests had left could we relax
It wasn’t until all the guests had left that we could relax
It wasn’t until all the guests had left could we relax

exercises.explanation: Cả A (đảo ngữ) và B (câu chẻ nhấn mạnh) đều diễn đạt đúng nghĩa của câu gốc.

exercises.question: The phone stopped ringing the moment I got downstairs.

options.text: No sooner had the phone stopped ringing than I got downstairs
After the phone had stopped ringing, I got downstairs
Hardly had the phone stopped ringing when I got downstairs
No sooner had I got downstairs than the phone stopped ringing

exercises.explanation: Tôi vừa mới xuống cầu thang thì điện thoại ngừng reo (hành động xuống cầu thang hoàn thành trước, chia quá khứ hoàn thành đảo ngữ).

exercises.question: The light failed the moment they began working

options.text: But for the light failed, they would have begun work
Hardly did they begin work when the light failed
Hardly had they begun work when the light failed
As soon as the light failed, they began work

exercises.explanation: Họ vừa mới bắt đầu làm việc thì đèn tắt. Cấu trúc Hardly had + S + PII + when...

exercises.question: She didn’t shed a tear as the play ended in tragedy.

options.text: The tragedy play wasn’t good for her to shed tear
Without her tear, the play didn’t end tragically
So tragic was the play that she didn’t shed a tear
Not a tear did she shed when the play ended in tragedy

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ với 'Not a tear did she shed...' diễn đạt đúng và nhấn mạnh ý câu gốc.

exercises.question: It was not until she had arrived home _____ her appointment with the doctor.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc câu chẻ nhấn mạnh: It was not until + Clause + that + Clause.

exercises.question: Canada does not require that U.S citizens obtain passports to enter the country, and__.
exercises.explanation: Đồng tình phủ định ở cuối câu dùng 'either' kết hợp trợ động từ phủ định: 'Mexico doesn’t, either'.

exercises.question: ____________________, he would have been able to pass the exam.

options.text: If he studied harder last year
Provided he studied hard last year
Had he studied harder last year

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + PII.

exercises.question: ___________________ will Mr. Dennis be able to regain control of the company.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Only by + V-ing/Noun + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính: 'will Mr. Dennis be able...'

exercises.question: __________ had I arrived home than it began to rain.
exercises.explanation: Từ nhận biết 'than' đứng sau biểu thị cấu trúc 'No sooner... than'.

exercises.question: My father paid my fees. _______________that, I wouldn’t be here now.
exercises.explanation: Cả 'But for' và 'Had it not been for' đều diễn tả 'Nếu không có/Nếu không nhờ có...' trong giả thiết loại 3 hỗn hợp.

exercises.question: ____the government be forced into another election, it would be the favorite to win.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 1: Should + S + V (inf).

exercises.question: ___to make an appointment to see Dr Simons, she is available between 9.00 and 11.00.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 1 diễn tả giả thiết: Should you wish...

exercises.question: _________further problems with your printer, contact your deal for advice.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1: Should you have...

exercises.question: _____to accept the post, you will be expected to start work on 1st April.
exercises.explanation: Cả B (Should you decide) và C (If you decide) đều đúng cấu trúc điều kiện loại 1.

exercises.question: ________any further news, we will be in touch immediately.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 1: Should we hear...

exercises.question: ______ you wish to take advantage of the offer, kindly tick the box on your order.
exercises.explanation: Should đứng đầu câu làm đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 1.

exercises.question: _________ the film be a success, they may be rich soon
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ hoặc dùng câu điều kiện có 'should' -> 'Should the film be a success' hoặc 'If the film should be a success'. Do đó B & C đều chấp nhận được.

exercises.question: ________you change your mind, there will always be a job for you here.
exercises.explanation: Cả 'If you change' (B) và 'Should you change' (C) đều đúng.

exercises.question: _________, a large area of sea would be contaminated.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2 với động từ thường: Were + S + to-inf -> Were the chemical to leak.

exercises.question: _________, they would face Italy in the final.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2: Were + S + to-inf -> Were Germany to beat.

exercises.question: _________, he would not permit such bad behavior.

options.text: Had Mr Morgan still be headmaster

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 2 với 'be': Were + S + Noun -> Were Mr Morgan still headmaster.

exercises.question: _________, you would have got a high mark.

options.text: Should you given it in on time
Had you given it in on time
Were you given it in on time
Had you give it in on time

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + PII (given).

exercises.question: _________a lawyer, as her parents’ wishes, she would have earned a large salary.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + PII (become).

exercises.question: _________, I would have been held responsible.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had + S + PII (gone wrong).

exercises.question: _________ Henry, I might not have met you.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had it not been for + N.

exercises.question: _________they could have saved the vessels.

options.text: Should the coast guards been notified
Were the coast guards to been notified
Had the coast guards been notified
Had been the coast guards notified

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3 dạng bị động: Had the coast guards been notified.

exercises.question: Had _________ by phone, the airline could have warned them.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ 'Had they confirmed...' (PII).

exercises.question: _________ his solicitor’s advice, he would have made a serious mistake.
exercises.explanation: Cả 'But for' và 'Had it not been for' đều đúng cấu trúc điều kiện loại 3.

exercises.question: _________did he spend all his money but she also borrowed some from me.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'Not only + đảo ngữ, but S also V...'

exercises.question: _________had I left the office than the phone rang.
exercises.explanation: Liên từ 'than' đi kèm với 'No sooner'.

exercises.question: Hardly_________ the phone down when the boss rang back.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'Hardly had + S + PII ... when'.

exercises.question: Not until the bell rang_________ his work.
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did he finish.

exercises.question: Only after several months _________ to see the symptoms of the disease.
exercises.explanation: Only after + khoảng thời gian + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did we begin (sau did dùng động từ nguyên thể).

exercises.question: Never in my life _________ anyone drink as much as you.
exercises.explanation: Never in my life + đảo ngữ HTHT: have I seen.

exercises.question: Under the table _________a sleeping dog.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ với trạng từ vị trí: Under the table + động từ chính (was lying) + a sleeping dog.

exercises.question: Rarely _________been more excited.
exercises.explanation: Rarely + đảo ngữ quá khứ hoàn thành: had his brother.

exercises.question: Only later _________ all the facts made public.
exercises.explanation: Only later + đảo ngữ bị động quá khứ đơn: were (số nhiều theo all the facts) + S + PII (made).

exercises.question: _________what would happen, I wouldn’t have accepted the job.
exercises.explanation: Cả B (Had I realized - đảo ngữ loại 3) và C (If I had realized) đều diễn đạt đúng.

exercises.question: _________ for our new products that we had to take on more staff
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ 'Such + be + N + that...' -> Such was the demand.

exercises.question: Not only _________ his leg but he also injured his shoulder.
exercises.explanation: Not only đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did Harry break.

exercises.question: Little _________ suspect that the judge was the murderer.
exercises.explanation: Little + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did the police suspect (sau did dùng động từ nguyên mẫu suspect).

exercises.question: _________you see Helen, could you ask her to call me?
exercises.explanation: Cả If (A) và Should (B - đảo ngữ loại 1) đều đúng.

exercises.question: In no way _________ for the accident.
exercises.explanation: In no way + đảo ngữ bị động với can: can + S + be + PII -> can the bus be blamed.

exercises.question: So heavy _________ that all the trains had to be cancelled
exercises.explanation: So + adj + be + S + that... snowfall số ít nên dùng 'was'.

exercises.question: _________ interest rates they would lose the election.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 2: Were + S + to V.

exercises.question: __________had I got into the bath than someone knocked on the door.
exercises.explanation: Đi kèm liên từ 'than' -> 'No sooner ... than'.

exercises.question: _________ was the uncertainty that the financial markets remained closed
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Such + be + N + that... -> Such was the uncertainty.

exercises.question: Seldom _________so much rain in March.
exercises.explanation: Seldom đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ với there is/are: is there (rain không đếm được).

exercises.question: __________your identity has been checked will you be allowed in.
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause (HTHT) + đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề chính: 'will you be allowed in'.

exercises.question: Hardly had the play started_________ there was a power failure.
exercises.explanation: Hardly had S PII when Clause.

exercises.question: Rarely ________the Prime Minister made so inept a speech.
exercises.explanation: Rarely + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: has (chủ ngữ số ít 'the Prime Minister').

exercises.question: On no account_________ to take photographs backstage.
exercises.explanation: On no account + đảo ngữ bị động hiện tại đơn: are press photographers allowed.

exercises.question: Never before _________ so much money been spent to so little purpose!.
exercises.explanation: Never before + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành bị động: has so much money been spent.

exercises.question: _________had the trial proceedings begun when the judge was taken ill
exercises.explanation: Đi kèm với 'when' -> 'Hardly had... when'.

exercises.question: Only in the last few pages of the book ___ to realise the significance of the murder.
exercises.explanation: Only in... + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: do you come.

exercises.question: _________are the demands of her job that she is rarely able to take a holiday.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Such + be + N + that... (N ở đây là số nhiều: 'the demands of her job', động từ 'are').

exercises.question: Under no circumstances _________ consume alcohol
exercises.explanation: Under no circumstances + đảo ngữ với động từ khuyết thiếu: may audience members consume.

exercises.question: No sooner _________ than they started to argue.
exercises.explanation: No sooner had they got married than...

exercises.question: At no time _________ my new car
exercises.explanation: At no time + đảo ngữ: can you use.

exercises.question: Little _________ know that the police had them under surveillance.
exercises.explanation: Little + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did the gang know.

exercises.question: Never _________ me again.
exercises.explanation: Never đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ tương lai: will she love.

exercises.question: Not only _________ but she is also very intelligent.
exercises.explanation: Not only đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ với to be: is she beautiful.

exercises.question: No sooner _________ out than it rained.
exercises.explanation: No sooner had I gone out than... (vừa mới đi ra ngoài thì trời mưa).

exercises.question: Seldom _________ the guitar.
exercises.explanation: Seldom đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does he play.

exercises.question: Hardly _________ a word when her son came back.
exercises.explanation: Hardly đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ thể khẳng định: could she say.

exercises.question: Often _________ a meeting.
exercises.explanation: Often đứng đầu câu nhấn mạnh, cần đảo trợ động từ lên trước: do we have.

exercises.question: Many a time _________ he wants to marry me.
exercises.explanation: Many a time (nhiều lần) + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: has he said.

exercises.question: Only at weekend _________ my kids to Water Park.
exercises.explanation: Only at weekend + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: do I take.

exercises.question: So old _________ that she couldn't dance.
exercises.explanation: So + adj + be + S + that... -> So old was she that...

exercises.question: _________ here yesterday, you would have met me.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3: Had you been...

exercises.question: On the battle field _________.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ với cụm chỉ vị trí: On the battle field + động từ chính (lay) + chủ ngữ (the tanks).

exercises.question: At no time _________ greater opportunities.
exercises.explanation: At no time + đảo ngữ: 'have women had' (women số nhiều nên dùng 'have').

exercises.question: Not once _________ into her eyes.
exercises.explanation: Not once + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did he look.

exercises.question: _________ has the work been so easy.
exercises.explanation: Chọn trạng từ phủ định 'Never' đứng đầu câu làm đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành.

exercises.question: Nowhere _________ such cooperative staff.
exercises.explanation: Nowhere đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ: can you find.

exercises.question: Only once _________ late to school.
exercises.explanation: Only once + đảo ngữ: did he come (sau trợ động từ 'did' dùng nguyên thể 'come').

exercises.question: Never before _________ in an earnest attempt to resolve their differences.

options.text: have the leaders of these two countries met
the leaders of these two countries have met
have the leaders of these two countries meet
met the leaders of these two countries

exercises.explanation: Never before + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: have + S + PII (met).

exercises.question: Not only _________ at the post office, _________ at the grocery store.

options.text: does Mary work/but she also works
does Mary work/but does she also work
works Mary/but does she also work

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Not only + đảo ngữ, but S also V... (vế sau không đảo ngữ).

exercises.question: Seldom _________ a newspaper.
exercises.explanation: Seldom đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does Anna buy.

exercises.question: No sooner _________ the house than the phone started to ring.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc No sooner had she entered the house than...

exercises.question: Only by saving money _________ a house.
exercises.explanation: Only by + V-ing + đảo ngữ: can he buy.

exercises.question: Not even once _________ the truth.
exercises.explanation: Not even once + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: has he told.

exercises.explanation: Only by + V-ing (training hard) + đảo ngữ: can you become...

exercises.question: ______hard, you will get good results in the coming examination.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 1: Should you work hard...

exercises.question: Only when you grow up, _________the truth.
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause + đảo ngữ tương lai đơn: will you know.

exercises.question: Not only _________ to determine the depth of the ocean floor, but it is also used to locate oil.
exercises.explanation: Not only đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ bị động hiện tại đơn: is seismology used.

exercises.question: Not only……………….the exam but she also got a scholarship.
exercises.explanation: Not only đứng đầu câu + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: has she passed.

exercises.question: _______ he arrived at the bus stop when the bus came.
exercises.explanation: Hardly had + S + PII (arrived) ... when...

exercises.question: _____ my father sat down for lunch than there was a knock at the door
exercises.explanation: Đi kèm với 'than' -> 'No sooner had ... than'.

exercises.question: So little _____ about mathematics that the lecture was completely beyond me
exercises.explanation: So + trạng từ (little) + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did I know + that...

exercises.question: ___________he had to deliver the performance in front of the whole class

options.text: No sooner he had finished his rehearsal than
No sooner than he had his rehearsal finished
No sooner than he had finished his rehearsal
No sooner had he finished his rehearsal than

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc No sooner had he finished ... than...

exercises.question: Not until Kentucky’s Mammoth Cave had been completely explored in 1972____

options.text: when was its full extent realized
the realization of its full extent
that its full extent was realized

exercises.explanation: Not until + Clause/Time + đảo ngữ bị động quá khứ đơn: was its full extent realized.

exercises.question: Not until a monkey is several years old ___________ to exhibit signs of independence from its mother.
exercises.explanation: Not until + clause + đảo ngữ hiện tại đơn: does it begin.

exercises.question: Not only ___in the field of psychology but animal behavior is examined as well.
exercises.explanation: Not only + đảo ngữ bị động: is human behavior studied.

exercises.question: At the center of the Earth’s solar system _________
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ chỉ vị trí: At the center of... + lies the Sun.

exercises.question: Never before __________ such a beautiful waterfall
exercises.explanation: Never before + đảo ngữ hiện tại hoàn thành: have I seen.

exercises.question: The instructor blew his whistle and________
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc đảo ngữ toàn bộ với trạng từ chuyển động đầu câu: off + động từ chính (ran) + chủ ngữ (the runners).

exercises.question: Only when you become a real parent______the real responsibility.
exercises.explanation: Only when + clause + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính: will you understand.

exercises.question: Scarcely ………out the house when it started raining.
exercises.explanation: Scarcely had he got... when...

exercises.question: All the way along the winding street ____.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ chỉ chuyển động hướng: All the way along... + came (động từ chính quá khứ đơn) + he (wait, wait, is he a pronoun? If it is a pronoun, do we invert? Oh, the source has 'came he' but grammar says we don't invert pronouns. However, 'came he' or 'he came' is sometimes debated, let's check the PDF. The PDF has 'came he' or 'he came' or 'did he came'. Let's look: B: came he. So B is correct in this test.)

exercises.question: Not until _____ home _____ that he had taken someone else’s bike

options.text: did he get/ did he realized

exercises.explanation: Not until + clause (he got home) + đảo ngữ mệnh đề chính (did he realize).

exercises.question: Out _____ when the bell rang
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ: Out + động từ chính (ran) + chủ ngữ (the children).

exercises.question: _ should a young child be allowed to play with fireworks without adult supervision.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ khuyết thiếu, chọn cụm phủ định 'Under no circumstances' (Trong bất kỳ hoàn cảnh nào cũng không).

exercises.question: A little farther down the street_________

options.text: is the inn I used to stay at
there is an inn where I used to stay in
the inn is the place where I used to stay
is there an inn in which I used to stay

exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ toàn bộ: A little farther down the street + is (be) + the inn I used to stay at (S).

exercises.question: Hardly _________ when the argument begins.
exercises.explanation: Hardly had he arrived when...

exercises.question: Not until the end of the 19th century _______become a scientific discipline.
exercises.explanation: Not until + thời gian + đảo ngữ quá khứ đơn: did plant breeding (become).

exercises.question: ________taken my parents’ advice, I wouldn't be a teacher now.
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ câu điều kiện loại 3 (vế giả thiết trong câu điều kiện hỗn hợp 3-2): Had I (taken).

exercises.question: ________they arrived __________they were told to go back.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc Scarcely had they arrived... when...

exercises.question: Never_________him stand on the deserted station platform.
exercises.explanation: Never + đảo ngữ tương lai đơn: will I forget seeing (forget + V-ing: quên đã làm gì).

exercises.question: _______that Jane was able to retire at the age of 50.
exercises.explanation: So + adj + be + S + that... -> So successful was her business that...

exercises.question: Scarcely had he stepped out of the room _____ he heard a loud laughter within
exercises.explanation: Scarcely had ... when...

exercises.question: _______ you known he was a liar, would you have agreed to support him?
exercises.explanation: Đảo ngữ điều kiện loại 3: Had you known...

exercises.question: I am not going to study French and__________
exercises.explanation: Đồng tình phủ định đảo ngữ với Neither: neither is he.
